description: Jubilee General Insurance Company Limited is one of Pakistan's three largest general insurers by gross direct premium, in operation since 1953 and now in its eighth decade. It writes general insurance for corporate, commercial and individual clients through a nationwide branch network, and since May 2015 has also run Window Takaful operations for Shariah-compliant cover. Its major shareholders include the Aga Khan Hospital and Medical College Foundation and Habib Bank Limited, and it is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.
